svg.aria-label: Pelvic floor muscles seen from above — 盆底肌（上面观）

text.aria-label: Pelvic floor muscles seen from above — 盆底肌（上面观）
text.tspan: Pelvic floor muscles seen from above

text.aria-label: Anterior (pubis) — 前（耻骨）
Posterior (sacrum and coccyx) — 后（骶骨和尾骨）
Puborectalis (U-shaped sling) — 耻骨直肠肌（U 形吊带）
text.tspan: 耻骨直肠肌（U 形吊带）

text.aria-label: Pubococcygeus — 耻骨尾骨肌
Iliococcygeus — 髂骨尾骨肌
Coccygeus (on the sacrospinous ligament) — 尾骨肌（贴在骶棘韧带上）
text.tspan: 尾骨肌（贴在骶棘韧带上）

text.aria-label: Tendinous arch of levator ani — 肛提肌腱弓
Ischial spine — 坐骨棘
Pubic symphysis — 耻骨联合
Urethra — 尿道
Vagina (female) — 阴道（女性）
Perineal body — 会阴体
Anal canal and rectum — 肛管与直肠
Anococcygeal ligament — 肛尾韧带
Coccyx — 尾骨
Urogenital hiatus (gap between the two sides) — 尿生殖裂孔（两侧肌之间的裂隙）
text.tspan: Urogenital hiatus (gap between the two sides)
尿生殖裂孔（两侧肌之间的裂隙）

text.aria-label: Origin area — 起点区
Insertion area — 止点区
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Puborectalis — 耻骨直肠肌
Origin: back of the body of the pubis — 起点：耻骨体后面
text.tspan: Origin: back of the body of the pubis

text.aria-label: Insertion: sling behind the anorectal junction (no bone) — 止点：肛管直肠连接处后方的吊带（无骨性止点）
text.tspan: Insertion: sling behind the anorectal junction (no bone)
止点：肛管直肠连接处后方的吊带（无骨性止点）

text.aria-label: Pubococcygeus — 耻骨尾骨肌
Origin: back of the pubis, front of the tendinous arch — 起点：耻骨后面、腱弓前部
text.tspan: Origin: back of the pubis, front of the tendinous arch
起点：耻骨后面、腱弓前部

text.aria-label: Insertion: anococcygeal ligament, coccyx, perineal body — 止点：肛尾韧带、尾骨、会阴体
text.tspan: Insertion: anococcygeal ligament, coccyx, perineal body
止点：肛尾韧带、尾骨、会阴体

text.aria-label: Iliococcygeus — 髂骨尾骨肌
Origin: tendinous arch of levator ani, ischial spine — 起点：肛提肌腱弓、坐骨棘
text.tspan: Origin: tendinous arch of levator ani, ischial spine
起点：肛提肌腱弓、坐骨棘

text.aria-label: Insertion: coccyx and anococcygeal ligament — 止点：尾骨和肛尾韧带
Coccygeus — 尾骨肌
Origin: ischial spine — 起点：坐骨棘
Insertion: lateral margin of the lower sacrum and coccyx — 止点：骶骨下部和尾骨的外侧缘
text.tspan: Insertion: lateral margin of the lower sacrum and coccyx
止点：骶骨下部和尾骨的外侧缘

text.aria-label: Levator ani = puborectalis + pubococcygeus + iliococcygeus. — 肛提肌 = 耻骨直肠肌 + 耻骨尾骨肌 + 髂骨尾骨肌。
text.tspan: 肛提肌 = 耻骨直肠肌 + 耻骨尾骨肌 + 髂骨尾骨肌。

text.aria-label: The model has no pelvic floor muscles; they are drawn — 模型没有盆底肌；它们是在模型骨盆上示意画的
text.tspan: The model has no pelvic floor muscles; they are drawn
模型没有盆底肌；它们是在模型骨盆上示意画的

text.aria-label: schematically on the model pelvis (upper pelvis removed). — （骨盆上部已去掉）。
text.tspan: schematically on the model pelvis (upper pelvis removed).
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
